The season began on 11 July 2026, and will have a 3-month winter break between December 2026 and March 2027. The regular season will end on 29 May 2027 and will be followed by promotion play-offs. == Team changes == ===To First League=== ; Promoted from [[2025–26 Russian Second League Division A|Second League Division A]] * [[FC Leningradets Leningrad Oblast|Leningradets Leningrad Oblast]] * [[FC Tekstilshchik Ivanovo|Tekstilshchik Ivanovo]] * [[FC Veles Moscow|Veles Moscow]] ;
